section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study 1) examining self-compassion as a protective factor for body appreciation among 263 women (Mage = 35.26) in an online sample. The study investigated whether self-compassion moderated the relationships between body-related threats (body comparison and appearance contingent self-worth) and body appreciation, finding that high self-compassion buffered against these negative relationships.
